company.name: Legendary Entertainment
company.shortDescription: Legendary Entertainment is an entertainment company focused on producing digital comics and television.
company.description: Legendary Entertainment is a media company that creates and distributes content for television and digital platforms around the world. Through a strategic partnership with other production studios, the company creates, develops, co-produces, co-finances, and distributes motion pictures dedicated to owning, producing, and delivering content to mainstream audiences with a targeted focus on the powerful fandom demographic. It owns, produces, and distributes box-office movies and films, television shows, and comic story lines.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Secondary Market round raised $150,000,000, or 4.02% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 11 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $55,886,131 to $4,000,000,000, a 71.57x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 91 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 49 (+18).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
